tasks.title: Conversation #92
tasks.transcript:
Man: Did you happen to check the weather forecast for tomorrow?
Woman: I did. It's not looking good. They're predicting steady rain and possible thunderstorms throughout the day.
Man: That's disappointing. Well, the nature photography workshop at the Botanical Gardens won't work out. We'll have to find something else for our class field trip.
Woman: The City Museum is hosting a temporary exhibit on environmental photography.
It might be a good indoor alternative, and still relevant to our students.
Man: That actually sounds perfect. Let's do that instead.

questions.stem: Why did the speakers plan to go to the botanical gardens?

options.C: To take students on a field trip

questions.analysis: 答案：C 题目问的是：说话者为什么计划去植物园？ 定位原文：Man: Well, the nature photography workshop at the Botanical Gardens won't work out. We'll have to find something else for our class field trip. 选项分析： A. To take a boat tour 乘船游览。对话中未提及乘船，所以A选项错误。 B. To film an advertisement 拍摄广告。对话中提及的是“nature photography workshop”（自然摄影工作坊）和“class field trip”（班级实地考察），并非拍广告，所以B选项错误。 C. To take students on a field trip 带学生进行实地考察。男士明确说这是“class field trip”，且需要为班级另找活动，所以C选项正确。 D. To research a class assignment 为课堂作业做研究。对话中未提及作业研究，而是实地考察活动，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: What does the woman imply about a museum?

options.A: It does not allow flash photography.
options.C: It will be a less expensive option than the gardens.
options.D: It will not be affected by bad weather.

questions.analysis: 答案：D 题目问的是：女士提到博物馆暗示了什么？ 定位原文：Woman: The City Museum is hosting a temporary exhibit on environmental photography. It might be a good indoor alternative, and still relevant to our students. 选项分析： A. It does not allow flash photography. 博物馆不允许使用闪光灯拍照。对话中未提及拍照规则，所以A选项错误。 B. It will be closed soon. 博物馆很快就要关门了。对话中未提及闭馆时间，所以B选项错误。 C. It will be a less expensive option than the gardens. 它会是比植物园更便宜的选择。对话中未比较费用，所以C选项错误。 D. It will not be affected by bad weather. 它不会受到坏天气的影响。女士提到博物馆是“indoor alternative”（室内替代方案），而原计划的植物园活动因雨天无法进行，暗示博物馆在室内，不受天气影响，所以D选项正确。
